row.evidence: Figma's pricing page includes "Single sign-on (SSO) ... manage provisioning via SCIM" on Organization and Enterprise, and the SCIM help article says it is "Available on the Organization and Enterprise plans"; the developer docs add "SCIM is not supported on the Starter or Professional Plan."
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated) but the SCIM plan moves from Enterprise (June) to Organization: the pricing page SSO row ('manage provisioning via SCIM') is included on Organization and Enterprise, and Figma's SCIM help article and developer docs confirm Organization. June's price points are unchanged (Professional $16, Organization $55, Enterprise $90 per full seat/mo billed annually), so the multiplier is now 55/16 = 3.4 instead of 5.6. Enterprise-only extras: SCIM seat-type management (roles seatType), figmaAdmin via SCIM, role assignment via SCIM, Activity Logs API. On Organization everyone provisioned gets a free View seat and seats are set inside Figma.

auth.token_source: Admin > Settings > Access > Authentication > SCIM Provisioning > Generate API token (shown once); Governance+ multi-IdP: per-IdP tokens

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users are removed from the organization and lose all permissions; on reactivation someone must manually re-add them to previous teams, folders and files. DELETE permanently deletes the user.

custom.how: Figma extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:figma:enterprise:2.0:User (figmaAdmin, Enterprise only); POST Users 'also supports custom parameters'.

roles.how: Enterprise only: SCIM roles attribute {type: seatType, value: Full|Dev|Collab|View} sets seat type; figmaAdmin boolean sets org admin. Groups map to workspaces and billing groups by displayName.

limitations.text: SAML SSO must be configured before SCIM.
On Organization, seat type cannot be set from the IdP; everyone joins on a free View seat. Seat management via SCIM is Enterprise only.
SCIM and SAML only apply to organization members, not guests.
No bulk, sort or etag support; filter maxResults 200 in ServiceProviderConfig.
Reactivated users must be re-added manually to teams, folders and files.

capabilities.notes: The REST API only returns the authenticated user (GET /v1/me) and is mostly read-only; user lifecycle is via the SCIM API only.

rate_limits.text: Rate limits vary by seat, plan, and API endpoint.

okta.notes: OIN markup checks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push.

google.notes: Google Admin console Web and mobile apps > Figma > Configure autoprovisioning (from Figma's guide).
